title: Conservative atomistic derivative audit of energy-layer Mirror perturbations
hypothesis: A low-dimensional Mirror code inserted only into a scalar invariant energy model yields force fields that are exactly conservative and rotation equivariant when forces are derived as negative energy gradients; a separately perturbed force head does not.
mirror_coordinate: Rank-2 coefficient code inside energy layer
controls: rank-2 Mirror energy with gradient forces

development.selection_metric: no tuning; verify finite-difference residual and rotation covariance

success_gate: For both distinct Mirror codes, max finite-difference force-gradient residual <1e-7 and max rotation-equivariance residual <1e-10 in every fresh world; the separate-force-head negative control must exceed the gradient-residual threshold.
failure_gate: Gradient or equivariance violation in energy-derived force; or negative control is not detected.
boundaries: Synthetic radial mechanism audit only, not a trained MACE/NequIP result.
Passing establishes physical consistency of this insertion, not quality, capacity, byte savings, or natural material transfer.
